dominant coverage of kp_cs230_product_management_bottleneck_in_ai_assisted_development plus substantial support from kp_cs230_engineer_product_empathy; the build-feedback-revise loop gives concrete product scenarios for deciding what the real bottleneck is in AI-assisted development.

career-environment guidance centered on peers, faculty connections, and team choice; despite dominant coverage of kp_cs230_career_network_and_team_quality, this is anecdotal/advisory content and not in course_config.included_content_types.

interview-story and personal-advice segment built around collaboration signals and effort norms; the hostile-candidate story is concrete, but the unit is primarily anecdotal rather than conceptual, derivational, or workflow-heavy.
market-reset discussion grounded in 2022-2025 hiring slowdown and overhiring correction; this is historical/job-market context, not included content under course_config.included_content_types.

dominant coverage of the structured framework kp_cs230_three_pillars_for_ai_career_success; the depth-business-delivery triad is explicit enough to support conceptual comparison and classification items rather than pure advice recall.

substantial coverage of kp_cs230_production_first_ai_mindset and kp_cs230_ai_risk_mitigation_and_evolving_responsibility; the production-vs-demo distinction and the concrete safety-filter failure example support diagnostic items about business value, risk, and responsibility tradeoffs.

dominant coverage of kp_cs230_technical_debt_in_generated_code; the unit defines technical debt and uses spaghetti-code and authority-over-merit examples to diagnose failure modes in generated-code workflows.

worked case built around the agent request and the repeated 'why?' decomposition; substantial coverage of kp_cs230_hype_filtering_and_trusted_advising and kp_cs230_problem_first_ai_solution_design supports diagnostic items about separating a technology request from the underlying business problem.

closing Q&A mixes surprise stories, adoption anecdotes, and general research caution; despite a partial diagnostic theme around validation, the unit is diffuse and primarily anecdotal.
